blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Point cloud transformers aim to capture detailed local geometry and relationships across a scene at a manageable computational cost. Two common approaches are window attention and global attention. They differ in how they enable scene-wide interaction, which refers to information exchange among tokens across a scene. Window attention reduces computational cost by restricting self-attention to groups of tokens called windows; in serialized designs, each window contains a fixed number of consecutive tokens from a spatially ordered sequence. Because each block only directly connects tokens within the same window, information exchange across windows relies on changes in window membership across blocks and hierarchical pooling. Global attention, in contrast, directly connects all tokens within a scene, but computing attention over all token pairs can be costly when the number of tokens is large. To balance computational cost and scene-wide interaction, we introduce MixPT, a point transformer that uses a mix of window and global attention blocks in an interleaved schedule, while retaining a single fixed serialization pattern for its window blocks. For scenes with a large number of tokens, MixPT applies global attention to spatially pooled tokens and returns residual updates to the original-resolution stream. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, MixPT achieves competitive accuracy with lower latency than representative window and global attention baselines. We further demonstrate the feasibility of scaling the attention stage in depth by repeating the interleaved pattern of window and global attention blocks.
blocks.zh: 点云变压器旨在以可控的计算成本,捕捉整个场景的详细局部几何和关系. 两种共同做法是窗口关注和全球关注。 它们在如何促成全场互动方面有所不同,这是指整个场景的标志之间的信息交流. 窗口注意通过将自我注意限制在称为窗口的几组信使上,从而降低计算成本;在序列化设计中,每个信使窗口都包含一个空间顺序的固定数的连续信使. 由于每个块只在同一窗口内直接连接符号,所以不同窗口之间的信息交流依赖于不同块间窗口成员的变化和等级集合. 与此相对照,全球关注直接连接一个场景内的所有信物,但当信物数量大时,计算所有信物对的注意力可能代价高昂. 为了平衡计算成本和全场互动,我们引入了MixPT,即一个点变器,它使用窗口和全局关注区块在互换的时表中的组合,同时为其窗口区块保留单一的固定序列化模式. 对于拥有大量符号的场景,MixPT将全球注意力应用于空间集合符号,并将剩余更新返回原解析流. 在整个室内外基准中,MixPT实现竞争性精确度,其延迟度低于代表性窗口和全球关注基线。 我们进一步表明,通过重复窗口和全球关注区块的互开模式来扩大关注阶段的可行性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Deep learning for point clouds has advanced through architectures that learn geometric representations from point sets or sparse spatial grids ( Qi et al., 2017a ; Qi et al., 2017b ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Wu et al., 2019 ; Thomas et al., 2019 ; Graham et al., 2018 ; Choy et al., 2019 ; Hu et al., 2020 ) .
More recently, point transformers ( Zhao et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) use attention to exchange information among tokens at different spatial locations.
At a fixed spatial resolution ( i.e. , after voxel sampling with the same voxel size), larger 3D scenes typically retain more points and therefore require more input tokens, increasing the computational cost of attention.
blocks.zh:
深入学习点云,通过从点集或稀疏的空间网格中学习几何表示力的建筑学得到了进步(Qi等,2017a; Qi等,2017b;Wang等,2019;Wu等,2019;Thomas等,2019;Graham等,2018;Choy等,2019;Hu等,2020.).
最近,点变压器 ("赵等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"赵等";"赵等";"赵等";"赵等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"赵等";"赵等";"赵等";"吴等";"吴等"吴等";"吴等"吴等";";"吴等";"吴等";"吴等";"))利用注意在不同空间位置的标志间交流信息.
在固定的空间分辨率上(即以同等同的花瓶大小进行花瓶采样后),较大的3D场景通常会保留更多的分数,因此需要更多的输入符,从而增加注意的计算成本.

blocks.en:
Two common approaches make different choices in the trade-off between attention cost and scene-wide interaction: window attention and global attention.
Window attention reduces computational cost by restricting self-attention to groups of tokens called windows, so each block only directly connects tokens within the same window ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) .
Global attention, in contrast, directly connects all tokens within a scene, but computing attention over all token pairs can be costly when the number of tokens is large ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) .
This contrast motivates using a mix of window and global attention blocks: can window attention retain its computational efficiency while selected global blocks directly exchange information across windows?
blocks.zh:
两种共同办法在注意力成本和全场互动之间的权衡上作出不同的选择:窗口注意力和全球注意力。
窗口关注通过将自意限制在称为窗口的几组信使上来降低计算成本,因此每个块仅在同一个窗口内直接连接信使(Wu等,2024;Yue等,2026).
与此相反,全球关注直接连接了场景内的所有指使,但当指使数量大时,计算所有指使对的指使的注意力可能代价高昂(Yilmaz等,2026年).
这种对比激发了使用窗口和全局关注块的组合:窗口关注能否保留其计算效率,而选定的全局块则直接在窗口之间交换信息?

blocks.en:
Introducing global blocks also provides an opportunity to simplify how window blocks exchange information across windows.
Serialized window attention spatially orders tokens and groups consecutive tokens into fixed-size windows.
To indirectly exchange information across windows, these designs change serialization patterns across blocks to alter window membership and use hierarchical pooling to aggregate features at coarser resolutions ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) .
Keeping a single serialization pattern instead allows token ordering and window grouping to be reused across blocks, reducing processing overhead, but removes the interaction paths created by changing window membership.
Interleaving global attention blocks allows tokens in different windows to directly exchange information while keeping window membership fixed across window attention blocks.
blocks.zh:
引入全局块也为简化窗口块如何在窗口之间交换信息提供了机会.
串行化窗口注意空间订购符并相继将符分入固定大小的窗口.
为了间接地在窗口之间交换信息,这些设计会改变跨块的序列化模式来改变窗口的会籍,并使用分级集合在相近分辨率下进行集合(Wu等,2024;Yue等,2026).
相反,保持单一的序列化模式,可以使令牌订购和窗口分组被跨块再用,减少处理间接费用,但可以去除通过改变窗口成员而创建的交互路径.
互通全球关注块可以让不同窗口中的指使直接交换信息,同时将窗口成员固定在窗口关注块之间.

blocks.en:
We therefore introduce MixPT, a point transformer that uses a mix of window and global attention blocks in an interleaved schedule.
Its window blocks reuse a single fixed serialization pattern, while global blocks periodically enable direct information exchange across windows.
For scenes with a large number of tokens, MixPT applies global attention to spatially pooled tokens and returns only the resulting residual updates to the original-resolution stream.
This design retains window attention at the original stage resolution while controlling the cost of global attention through the frequency of global blocks and the number of pooled tokens.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们引入了MixPT,一个点变器,在一个相隔的时间安排中使用窗口和全局关注块的组合.
它的窗口区块重新使用单一的固定序列化模式,而全球区块则能定期实现跨窗口的直接信息交流.
对于有大量符号的场景,MixPT将全球注意力应用于空间集合符号,并只将由此产生的剩余更新返回到原始解析流.
这种设计保留了最初阶段分辨率的窗口关注,同时通过全球块的频率和集合符号的数量控制全球关注的成本.

blocks.en:
MixPT-S, which is our smallest model variant, uses the WWGWWGWW attention schedule illustrated in Fig. 1 , where W and G denote window and global attention blocks, respectively.
Across indoor and outdoor 3D scene understanding benchmarks, MixPT-S achieves competitive accuracy with lower latency per forward pass than representative window and global attention baselines.
Our ablations show accuracy gains from periodically introducing global blocks compared with using fixed windows alone.
We further demonstrate the feasibility of increasing the attention stage’s depth by repeating the interleaved pattern of window and global attention blocks.
blocks.zh:
MixPT-S是我们最小的模型变体,它使用图1所显示的WWGWWGWW关注表,W和G分别表示窗口和全球关注块.
在整个室内外三维场景理解基准中,MixPT-S实现竞争精度,每前行通行证的延迟度低于代表性窗口和全球关注基线.
我们的模拟显示,与仅使用固定窗口相比,定期采用全球区块具有准确性。
我们进一步表明,通过重复窗口和全球关注块的互通模式来增加关注阶段的深度是可行的。

blocks.en:
In sum, our contributions are threefold.
First, we analyze how cross-window communication develops in serialized window attention and how the use of scene-wide support varies across global attention blocks.
Second, we propose MixPT, which interleaves fixed-order window and global attention, with pooled global attention for large token sets.
Finally, we demonstrate a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off across indoor and outdoor benchmarks and analyze the effects of block arrangement, pooling resolution, and model scaling.
blocks.zh:
总之,我们的贡献有三重。
首先,我们分析跨窗口通信如何在串行化窗口注意力中发展,以及全场支持的使用如何因全球关注块而异.
其次,我们提议MixPT, 将固定顺序窗口和全球注意力相互连接, 将全球注意力集中到大型符号集。
最后,我们展示了一种在室内和室外基准之间有利的精确度和相关性取舍,并分析了区块安排、集中分辨率和模型规模的影响。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early point-based backbones learned permutation-invariant features directly from unordered point sets and introduced hierarchical neighborhood aggregation to capture local geometry ( Qi et al., 2017a ; Qi et al., 2017b ) .
Subsequent methods developed richer local point operators, scalable sampling strategies, and efficient model scaling ( Wang et al., 2019 ; Wu et al., 2019 ; Thomas et al., 2019 ; Hu et al., 2020 ; Thomas et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2022 ) , while sparse voxel approaches ( Graham et al., 2018 ; Choy et al., 2019 ; Zhu et al., 2021 ) and an octree-based approach ( Riegler et al., 2017 ) restricted feature storage and computation to occupied regions.
These approaches established local aggregation and hierarchical processing as effective foundations for large-scale point cloud understanding, which later point transformers build upon.
blocks.zh:
早期基于点的骨干直接从无序点集中学习出穿行-变相特征,并引入了分级相邻地集,以捕捉局部几何(Qi等,2017a; Qi等, 2017b. (简体中文).
随后的方法开发出更丰富的局部点操作器,可伸缩的采样策略,以及高效的模型缩放(Wang等,2019;Wu等,2019;Thomas等,2019;Hu等,2020;Thomas等,2024;Qian等,2022;),而稀有的活塞方法(Graham等,2018;Choy等,2019;Zhu等,2021)和以果树为主的方法(Riegler等,2017)限制特征存储和计算到被占用地区.
这些方法确立了局部聚合和分级处理,是了解大分点云的有效基础,后来的分点变压器在此基础上更上一层楼.

blocks.en:
Scaling point cloud transformers to large scenes requires controlling the number of point interactions and the cost of organizing them.
Early point transformers restrict attention to local neighborhoods, using nearest neighbors or spatial partitions to capture local geometry at manageable cost ( Zhao et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2022 ) .
Later methods improve scalability by sharing spatial groups across queries ( Fan et al., 2022 ; Lai et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) , adapting window geometry ( Lai et al., 2023 ; Duan et al., 2023 ) , and forming fixed-size token groups for efficient batched attention ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Wang, 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) .
PTv3 ( Wu et al., 2024 ) adopts serialized windows and changes serialization patterns across blocks to facilitate communication between groups.
We refer to its attention patches as windows throughout this paper.
Efficiency also depends on the spatial resolution at which attention operates.
LitePT ( Yue et al., 2026 ) uses sparse convolution at high resolution and retains serialized window attention in later stages.
Volt ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) instead applies global attention to volumetric patch tokens, controlling attention cost through token count rather than restricting the interaction range.
blocks.zh:
将点云变压器放大到大场景,需要控制点相互作用的数量和组织成本.
早期点变电所将注意力限制在了当地街区,利用相距相近的邻居或空间分来以可控成本捕捉出局部几何(赵等,2021;吴等,2022;朴等,2022.
后期方法通过共享跨查询的空间组(Fan等,2022;Lai等,2022;Yang等,2023;Lai等,2023;Duan等,2023;)来提高可伸缩性,并形成可高效分批注意的固定尺寸的代号组(Liu等,2023;Wang等,2023;Wang等,2023).
PTv3(Wu等,2024年)采用串行式窗口并改变跨块的串行式来方便各组之间的交流.
我们在整个本文中都把它的注意力作为窗口。
效率还取决于注意力运作的空间分辨率。
LitePT(Yue等,2026年)在高分辨度下使用稀疏的分解法并保留后期的串行化窗口注意力.
Volt (Yilmaz等, 2026年)转而将全球注意力应用到批量补丁符号上,通过符号计数控制注意力成本,而不是限制交互范围.

blocks.en:
Interleaving local and global attention provides a way to preserve efficient local processing while introducing broader communication only at selected layers.
Global context can be introduced through compact representations that interact with local features ( Chu et al., 2021 ; Hatamizadeh et al., 2024 ; Hatamizadeh et al., 2023 ) , or through sparse connections between distant tokens ( Tu et al., 2022 ) .
These designs reduce the cost of global communication while preserving detailed features within each window.
A complementary strategy retains full global attention but reserves it for selected layers, using window attention elsewhere, as adopted in vision backbones ( Li et al., 2022 ; Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Ravi et al., 2025 ; Carion et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) .
This principle also extends to language modeling, where sliding window attention is interleaved with causal attention over the full context ( Gemma Team et al., 2024 ; Gemma Team et al., 2025 ) .
However, the studies discussed above primarily explore this design principle in image and language models.
Thus, in this paper, we study its application to serialized point cloud backbones, focusing on fixed window grouping and the spatial resolution of global attention.
blocks.zh:
将地方和全球的注意力分开,为保持高效率的本地处理提供了一种方法,同时只在选定的层次上引入更广泛的通信。
全球背景可以通过与当地特征相互作用的紧凑表述(Chu等,2021;Hatamizadeh等,2024;Hatamizadeh等,2023)来引入,或者通过远方信使之间的稀疏联系(Tu等,2022)来引入.
这些设计降低了全球通信的成本,同时在每个窗口内保留了详细的功能.
一项补充战略保留了全球的全部注意力,但保留在选定的层次上,在其他地方利用视窗注意力(Li等,2022;Kirillov等,2023;Ravi等,2025;Carion等,2026;Bai等,2025)。
这一原则还延伸到语言建模,即滑动窗口的注意力与整个背景的因果关注相接(Gemma Team等,2024;Gemma) Team等,2025 (英语).
然而,上文所讨论研究主要探索了图像和语言模型中的这一设计原则.
因此,在本文中,我们研究了它对序列点云主干线的应用,侧重于固定窗口分组和全球关注的空间分辨率.

blocks.en:
Rotary positional embedding (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2024 ) has been extended to 3D points using axial formulations ( Li and Harada, 2022 ) .
Recent point cloud transformers use both symmetric ( Yue et al., 2026 ; Choy et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) and asymmetric ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) channel allocations across the three spatial axes.
We adopt an asymmetric allocation in MixPT and examine its effect in our ablations.
blocks.zh:
扶轮定位嵌入法(ROPE)(Su等,2024年)被扩展为使用轴配体的3D点(Li和Harada,2022年).
近点云变压器既使用对称(岳等,2026;乔伊等,2026;张等,2026)又使用对称(叶尔玛兹等,2026)横跨三个空间轴的通道分配.
我们在MixPT中采用了非对称分配法,并研究它在我们身上的影响。

blocks.en:
Given N N tokens, window attention partitions them into windows of N w N_{\mathrm{w}} tokens each and computes self-attention only within each window, reducing the number of pairwise interactions from 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) to 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ N w ) \mathcal{O}(NN_{\mathrm{w}}) .
Because tokens in different windows cannot interact directly, serialized window transformers rely on changes in serialization pattern and hierarchical pooling for cross-window communication ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) .
Alternating the serialization pattern changes window membership across blocks, while hierarchical pooling aggregates information at coarser resolutions.
PTv3 ( Wu et al., 2024 , Table 2) reports lower segmentation accuracy with a single fixed serialization pattern than with multiple patterns, suggesting that varying serialization patterns can be beneficial in practice.

由于不同窗口中的指使无法直接相互作用,相继化的窗口变压器依赖于序列化模式和分级集合的变化来进行跨窗口通信(Wu等,2024;Yue等,2026).
将序列化模式改变为不同块的窗口成员,而分级集成信息则以相近分辨率进行.

blocks.en:
To assess these mechanisms, we examine how token reachability expands across successive blocks.
Here, a token is considered reachable if it can be connected to the selected token through preceding attention blocks and hierarchical pooling transitions.
We measure this structural reachability from the attention stage input tokens, excluding receptive fields accumulated in the preceding convolutional stages.
As shown in Fig. 2 and Fig. 3 , LitePT-S ( Yue et al., 2026 ) , a representative window attention backbone,
did not achieve 100% mean token reachability on the Waymo validation set ( Sun et al., 2020 ) even in its deepest attention blocks, despite hierarchical pooling and changes in serialization pattern.
In contrast, Volt-S ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) , a representative global attention backbone, has full structural reachability from its first block.
These observations motivate introducing global attention early in the stage to establish full structural reachability without relying solely on gradual propagation through window attention and hierarchical transitions.
MixPT-S therefore places its first global block after two window blocks, while retaining a fixed serialization for its window blocks.
blocks.zh:
为了评估这些机制,我们审查象征性的可达到性如何跨越相继的街区。
这里,如果一个符号可以通过先前的注意块和分级集合过渡与所选的符号相接,那么它就被认为是可以到达的.
我们从注意阶段输入符号中衡量这种结构可达到性,不包括前一个演化阶段所积累的可接受领域。
如图2和图3所示,LitePT-S(Yue等,2026年)是具有代表性的窗口关注主干线,
在Waymo验证集(Sun等人,2020年)上,尽管分级集合和序列化模式发生变化,但即使在最深层的注意力区块上,也未能实现100%的表示可达性。
相形之下,具有代表性的全球关注中枢的Volt-S(Yilmaz等,2026年)从第一个区块开始,具有完全的结构可达到性.
这些意见促使全球在早期阶段就注意建立完全的结构可达到性,而不仅仅依靠通过窗口注意力和等级过渡逐步传播。
因此,MixPT-S将其第一个全局块放在两个窗口块后,同时保留其窗口块的固定序列.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 3 , global attention achieves full structural reachability, but we ask whether its weights are also broadly distributed across tokens in every block.
To this end, we analyze a) how concentrated attention is within each block and b) where a selected query assigns its attention within the scene.
First, normalized attention entropy measures how evenly a query distributes attention over the keys it can attend to ( Oh and Schuler, 2022 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) : a value of one indicates uniform attention over the available keys, while lower values indicate greater concentration on a subset.
For each block, we compute this quantity for every query and head, average over queries and heads within each scene, and then average the scene-level values equally across scenes. Fig. 4 shows higher entropy in the early Volt-S blocks and lower entropy in several later blocks, indicating that the concentration of attention varies across depth.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,全球关注可实现完全的结构可达性,但我们问其权重是否也广泛分布在每个区块的标志上。
为此,我们分析a)在每个区块内如何集中注意力;b)一个选定的查询在现场内分配注意力。
首先,常态化的注意 en度测量一个查询如何均衡地将注意力分配到它可以处理的密钥上(Oh和Schuler, 2022;Zhai等, 2023):一个值表示对可用密钥的注意一致,而更低的值则表示对子集的更集中.

Second, we visualize the relative attention weights for a selected Volt query to show where attention concentrates within each block ( Fig. 5 ).
Although each block allowed global interactions, attention for this query tended to concentrate on localized regions in later blocks.
Together, these observations suggest that attention can become more concentrated at some depths despite having scene-wide support at every block.
These two key observations motivate the periodic use of global attention in MixPT-S for direct cross-window information exchange without computing attention between all token pairs in every block.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们可视化选定Volt查询的相对关注权重,以显示每个区块内的注意力集中之处(图5)。
虽然每个区块都允许全球互动,但对这一查询的关注往往集中在后几个区块的局部区域。
这些观察表明,尽管每个街区都有全场支持,但注意力可以更加集中在一些深度。
这两个关键观测激发了在MixPT-S中定期使用全球关注来直接进行跨窗口的信息交流,而不计算出每个区块中所有令牌对子之间的关注.

blocks.en:
Panels (a)–(c) of Fig. 6 illustrate the overall architecture of MixPT.
We retain the high-resolution sparse convolutional stages ( Fig. 6 (a)) and remaining decoder structure ( Fig. 6 (c)) of LitePT ( Yue et al., 2026 ) .
Our main architectural change centers on the attention stage ( Fig. 6 (b)).
We consolidate LitePT’s multiple attention stages ( Fig. 6 (d)) into a single stage by removing the intermediate pooling transition and the corresponding decoder upsampling.
We denote window and global attention blocks by W and G , respectively.
Within this stage, all window blocks reuse a single fixed serialization pattern, while global attention blocks are periodically interleaved following the WWGWWGWW schedule.
Both block types use the same number of heads and the same per-head dimension.
We next describe the fixed-order window and global attention blocks that form this stage.

We evaluated semantic segmentation on the validation sets of SemanticKITTI ( Behley et al., 2019 ) , Waymo ( Sun et al., 2020 ) , nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) , and ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) , covering both outdoor LiDAR scans and indoor RGB-D scenes.
We abbreviate SemanticKITTI as Sem.KITTI in all tables for brevity.
The comparison includes PTv3 ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and LitePT-S ( Yue et al., 2026 ) as representative window attention baselines, and Volt-S ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) as a global attention baseline.
The main comparison reports results without test-time augmentation (TTA), using mean intersection over union (mIoU) and mean class accuracy (mAcc).
For semantic segmentation, we followed Volt ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) in using an exponential moving average (EMA) of model weights and applied the same protocol to MixPT and all reproduced baselines.
Training, evaluation, and baseline reproduction details are provided in Appendix B .
Full semantic segmentation results with TTA are reported in Table A4 .

blocks.en:
First, we demonstrate how MixPT balances semantic segmentation accuracy and inference latency relative to window and global attention baselines.
As shown in Table 1 , MixPT-S achieved the lowest latency across all four datasets, reducing latency by 19% to 32% relative to LitePT-S.
The gap was larger relative to Volt-S, the global attention baseline, on outdoor datasets where MixPT-S was 2.1 to 6.9 × \times faster.
A key source of efficiency is that MixPT constructs the serialization order and stage layout once and reuses them across window attention blocks.
Token reorganization therefore occurs only at stage entry and exit, whereas LitePT repeatedly gathers and scatters tokens across blocks.
On nuScenes, these serialization-related operations took 1.01 ms in MixPT-S ( Fig. 8 ), compared with 10.61 ms in LitePT-S; further analysis is provided in Appendix C .
Since the semantic segmentation head contributes only 0.04–0.25% of the full forward latency, the measured latency primarily reflects backbone computation.
Despite these latency reductions, MixPT-S matched or improved upon LitePT-S in mIoU across all four datasets when evaluated without TTA ( Table 2 ).
Together, these results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off across both indoor and outdoor scenes.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们演示MixPT如何平衡与窗口和全球关注基线相比的语义分解精度和推断延迟度。
如表1所示,MixPT-S在所有四个数据集中实现了最低的延迟,相对于LitePT-S,延迟率降低了19%至32%.
相对于全球关注基线Volt-S而言,MixPT-S室外数据集的差距更大,因为MixPT-S的频率为2.1至6.9×\times快.
效率的一个关键来源是MixPT一次构建了序列式顺序和相位布局,并把它们再用到窗口的注意力块上.
因此,只有在进入阶段和退出阶段才进行托肯重组,而LitePT则反复地收集并分散区块上的标志.
在nuScens中,这些与序列化有关的操作在MixPT-S(图8)中耗取了1.01 ms,而在LitePT-S中则耗取了10.61 ms;进一步的分析载于附录C.
由于语义分解头只贡献了全前方延时的0.04–0.25%,所测延时主要反映主干计算.
尽管有这些暂时性的减少,MixPT-S在未经TTA评估的所有四个数据集中,在mIoU的LitePT-S上进行了匹配或改进(表2)。
这些结果加在一起表明,在室内外的场景中,精确度和相对性都是有利的。

blocks.en:
We evaluated MixPT on the validation sets of ScanNet and ScanNet200 using a common PointGroup ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) head ( Table 3 ) to focus the comparison on backbone representations.
For Volt ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) , we replaced its original SPFormer ( Sun et al., 2023 ) task decoder with PointGroup.
Following the instance segmentation setup of LitePT ( Yue et al., 2026 ) , we used MixPT-S*, which extends MixPT-S with additional attention and convolution blocks, without applying EMA during instance segmentation training.
Overall, MixPT-S* remained competitive with the baselines across both datasets, suggesting that the interleaved window-global design extends beyond semantic segmentation.
Model configurations are detailed in Appendix A , while training and evaluation settings are provided in Appendix B.3 .

我们在ScanNet和ScanNet200的验证组上用一个共同的点组(Jiang等人,2020年)头(表3)对MixPT进行了评估,将比较重点放在骨干代表。
对于Volt(Yilmaz等,2026年),我们用PointGroup替换了它原来的SPFormer(Sun等,2023年)任务解码器.
在LitePT(Yue等,2026年)的实例分解设置后,我们使用了MixPT-S*,它将MixPT-S扩展为额外的关注和分解块,在实例分解训练中不应用EMA.
总体而言,MixPT-S*在两个数据集的基线方面仍然具有竞争力,这表明互开的窗口-全球设计超出了语义分解的范围。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 研究与分析

blocks.en: We provide empirical support for four design choices: i) fixed serialization with periodic global attention; ii) the arrangement of window and global attention blocks; iii) the global pooling stride; and iv) the allocation of RoPE dimensions across spatial axes.
blocks.zh: 我们为四种设计选择提供经验支持:(一) 固定序列化,并定期得到全球关注;(二) 窗口和全球关注区块的安排;(三) 全球集合步伐;以及(四) 空间轴上RoPE维度的分配。

blocks.en: Table 4: Fixed serialization and global attention ablation (w/o TTA, mIoU/ mAcc, %).Attention-stage depth and width were held fixed across variants.
blocks.zh: 表4:固定序列化和全球关注(w/o TTA,mIoU/mAcc,%) 注意阶段深度和宽度在变体之间固定。

blocks.en:
As presented in Table 4 , fixing the serialization pattern reduced latency on both datasets, while leaving mIoU nearly unchanged on SemanticKITTI and decreasing it on ScanNet.
Changing two of the eight window blocks to global blocks raised mIoU to 70.0% and 76.0%, respectively, with only a small increase in full-model latency.
On SemanticKITTI, the global-only reference was slightly faster but less accurate than the interleaved design.
Unlike the interleaved design, this variant applied attention only to pooled tokens, without window attention at the original stage resolution.
Overall, periodic global attention improved the accuracy of fixed serialization while preserving its latency advantage over multi-pattern window attention.
blocks.zh:
如表4所示,固定序列化模式减少了两个数据集的延迟性,同时在语义KITTI上mIoU几乎保持不变,在ScanNet上减少。
将8个窗口区块中的2个改为全球区块,将mIoU分别提升到70.0%和76.0%,而全型机能延迟性只略有增加.
在SemanticKITTI上,全局性参考稍快,但不及互出叶的设计准确.
与互放式设计不同,这个变体只将注意力应用到集合符上,在最初的阶段解析时没有窗口注意力.
总体而言,全球的定期关注提高了固定序列化的准确性,同时保持了相对于多型窗口关注的长期性优势.

blocks.en:
We varied the number and placement of window and global blocks to examine their effect on accuracy and latency ( Table 5 ).
Among the eight-block schedules, WWGWWGWW provided a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off on nuScenes and achieved the highest mIoU on ScanNet.
Increasing the number of global blocks did not consistently improve accuracy and incurred additional latency on nuScenes, supporting the use of global attention only periodically.
A deeper ten-block variant slightly improved nuScenes accuracy, but with more parameters and higher latency.

一个更深的"十块"变体略微地提高了nuScens的精度,但具有更多的参数和更高的延迟.

blocks.en:
We examined how the global pooling stride s s affected accuracy, latency, and memory.
On Waymo, pooling reduced full-model latency and, at s = 2 s=2 , even improved mIoU over full-resolution global attention ( Fig. 9 (a)).
Global block latency decreased with pooling across all three datasets, with the largest absolute reduction on Waymo ( Fig. 9 (b)).
For s ≥ 2 s\geq 2 , peak memory during global blocks fell below that of window blocks, while further pooling provided only modest additional reductions in global block memory ( Fig. 9 (c)).
Overall, these results suggest that global attention need not operate at full resolution.
An appropriate pooling stride can reduce its computational cost while preserving, or in some cases improving, segmentation accuracy.

我们研究了全球集合速度如何影响准确性、延迟性和记忆。

总体而言,这些结果表明,全球关注不必完全解决。
适当的集合速度可以降低其计算成本,同时保持或在某些情况下提高分化的准确性。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced MixPT, a point transformer that combines fixed-order window attention with periodically interleaved global attention blocks.
Our analysis motivates direct cross-window communication at selected layers, while spatial pooling reduces global attention cost for large token sets, with residual updates returned to the original-resolution stream.
Across indoor and outdoor 3D scene understanding benchmarks, MixPT achieves competitive accuracy, and MixPT-S shows lower per-forward latency than representative window and global attention baselines in semantic segmentation.
Ablations examine global block placement, pooling resolution, and scaling through repeated interleaved patterns, illustrating how MixPT controls when and at what spatial resolution global interaction occurs.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了MixPT,一种将固定顺序窗口注意力与定期互放的全球注意力块相结合的点变器.
我们的分析激发了部分地层的直接跨窗口通信,而空间集聚则降低了大型地标集的全球关注成本,剩余更新返回到原始分辨率流.
通过室内外的三维场景理解基准,MixPT实现了竞争精度,而MixPT-S在语义分解中显示的比代表性窗口和全球关注基线更低的活度.
缩放检查了全球块的放置,集合解析度,并通过反复的互放模式进行缩放,说明了MixPT在何时和何时发生空间分辨率全球相互作用时是如何控制的.

blocks.en:
Instance segmentation uses the PointGroup ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) framework on ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) and ScanNet200 ( Rozenberszki et al., 2022 ) .
The training settings are summarized alongside those for indoor semantic segmentation in Table A3 .

培训设置与室内语义分解设置汇总于表A3。

blocks.en:
The backbone includes both the encoder and the feature decoder that restores spatial resolution before the PointGroup head.
PTv3 ( Wu et al., 2024 ) retains its hierarchical decoder with attention blocks.
The asterisk (*) denotes variants augmented with additional attention and convolution blocks in LitePT-S* ( Yue et al., 2026 ) and MixPT-S*.
LitePT-S* uses attention at its coarsest decoder stage and convolutions at the three finer stages.
MixPT-S* appends two global attention blocks to the encoder and uses two convolutional blocks at each of its three decoder stages without decoder attention.
Volt ( Yilmaz et al., 2026 ) restores voxel features through a lightweight decoder based on linear projection and voxel shuffling.
Its published instance segmentation model additionally uses an SPFormer ( Sun et al., 2023 ) task decoder.
For our reproduction, we retain the voxel feature decoder and replace SPFormer with the common PointGroup head.
For PTv3, LitePT-S*, and MixPT-S*, the backbone and PointGroup head are jointly trained from scratch for instance segmentation.
In contrast, following Volt’s pretraining protocol, we initialize its backbone and feature decoder from the EMA weights of its ScanNet or ScanNet200 semantic segmentation model trained with CNN distillation, using the checkpoint corresponding to each dataset.
The pretrained backbone and feature decoder are then jointly fine-tuned with the PointGroup head without further EMA updates.

星号(*)表示在LitePT-S*(Yue等,2026年)和MixPT-S*中增加注意和分化的变体。
LitePT-S*在其最相近的解码阶段使用注意力,再在更细的三相阶段进行演化.
MixPT-S*在编码器上附加了两个全局关注区块,并在其三个解码器相中每个阶段使用两个解码器相接区块而无需解码器关注.

其已公布的实例分解模型还额外使用了SPFormer(Sun等,2023年)任务分解器.
为了复制,我们保留了活塞特性解码器,并用常见的点组头来取而代之.
对于PTv3,LitePT-S*和MixPT-S*,骨干和点组头从头到尾联合培训,例如分块化。
对比之下,在沃尔特的预训协议之后,我们开始使用CNN蒸馏技术训练的ScanNet或ScanNet200语义分解模型的EMA分量的骨干和特征解码器,使用每个数据集对应的检查点。
然后,与PointGroup头部进行联合微调,不作进一步的EMA更新。

blocks.en:
We follow the instance segmentation evaluation protocols of PTv3 ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and LitePT ( Yue et al., 2026 ) , reporting mAP 25 , mAP 50 , and mAP on ScanNet and ScanNet200.

blocks.en: B.4 Test-Time Augmentation and Fragments
blocks.zh: B.4 试验时间增强和碎片

blocks.en:
As described in Appendix B.1 , a TTA view is a transformed input scene, whereas fragments are test-time voxelized realizations obtained by selecting different representative points from occupied voxels rather than by spatially partitioning the scene.
At batch size one, each fragment requires a separate forward, with predictions aggregated first across fragments and then across TTA views. Fig. A1 shows the mean number of fragments per TTA view; across all TTA views, the total number of fragment forwards is 11.9 × \times , 12.3 × \times , and 13.1 × \times that of the identity view on SemanticKITTI, nuScenes, and ScanNet, respectively.
Because of this additional cost, our main comparisons use results without TTA.
Disabling TTA removes only the transformed views; fragment aggregation is retained to reduce sensitivity to the representative points selected during test-time voxelization.

如附录B.1所描述的,TTA视图是一个被转变的输入场景,而碎片则是通过从占用的花瓶中选择不同的代表点,而不是通过空间分出场景而获得的测试时间活化实现.
在批量尺寸一时,每个片段都需要一个单独的前方,预测首先在片段之间汇总,然后在TTA视图之间汇总. 发相. A1显示每TTA视图的片段平均数量;在所有TTA视图中,前方的片段总数分别为:11.9 ×\times;12.3 ×\times;以及13.1 ×\tims semanticKITTI,nuScenes和ScanNet上的身份视图.
由于这种额外的成本,我们的主要比较使用没有TTA的结果.
禁用TTA只去除已变换的视图;片段聚合被保留,以降低对测试时活化所选择的代表性点的敏感性.

blocks.en: Table A5: Serialization order ablation of MixPT-S (w/o TTA, mIoU/ mAcc, %).
blocks.zh: 表A5:MixPT-S的序列化顺序(w/o TTA,mIoU/mAcc,%).

blocks.en:
We use Trans Z-order ( TZ ) as the default serialization pattern.
Across all three datasets, performance varies only modestly across the tested fixed orders, with TZ achieving the highest mIoU.
Serialization overhead consists of two main components: code construction and stage layout.
Code construction encodes coordinates into serialization codes, sorts them to obtain the serialization order, and builds the inverse mapping, while the stage layout reorders features and coordinates once when entering the attention stage and restores the original order when leaving it.
The stage layout cost remains similar across serialization orders, whereas code construction is more expensive for the Hilbert-based alternatives in our implementation.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Trans Z-order(TZ)作为默认的序列化模式.
在所有三个数据集中,在经过测试的固定订单中,性能仅略有不同,TZ实现了最高的mIoU.
序列化间接费用由两个主要部分组成:代码构建和舞台布局.
代码构造将坐标编码为序列化代码,将它排序以获得序列化顺序,并构建反向映射,而舞台布局则在进入关注阶段时重排了一次特征和坐标,并离开时恢复了原来的顺序.
舞台布局成本在系列化订单中仍然相似,而Hilbert型替代品的代码构建在我们实施过程中成本更高。

场景范围用米来测量,而窗口和全球范围则用各自关注网格的单元格来测量.

blocks.en:
For window attention, we measure the axis ranges of each full 1,024-token serialized window on the attention-stage grid.
Across all four datasets, these windows span wider ranges along the horizontal axes than along the vertical axis.
For global attention, we measure the axis ranges of the scene-wide token set after dataset-specific pooling when s > 1 s>1 , or at the original attention-stage resolution when s = 1 s=1 .
A similar horizontal-vertical imbalance is observed on the resulting global-attention grid.
Because window and global ranges are measured on grids with different cell sizes, their cell counts should not be compared directly as physical distances.
blocks.zh:
对于窗口的注意,我们测量了注意力级网格上每个完整的1,024个托肯序列化窗口的轴距.
在所有四个数据集中,这些窗口沿着水平轴所覆盖的范围比沿着垂直轴所覆盖的范围要大.
对于全球关注,当S > 1 s>1时,我们在数据集特定集合后,或者当S=1 s=1时,在原始关注阶段分辨率下,我们测量全场信号集的轴距.
在由此产生的全球注意网格上也观察到类似的横向-纵向不平衡。
由于窗口和全局范围是在不同单元格大小的网格上测量的,因此其单元格计数不应被直接比作物理距离.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en:
This study focuses on establishing the effectiveness of interleaving window and global attention rather than exhaustively optimizing their arrangement.
Although we evaluate several block layouts, the best schedule may depend on the dataset, task, or model scale, and a more systematic search for when global interaction should be introduced remains an open direction.
blocks.zh:
本研究的重点是确定离去窗口和全球关注的有效性,而不是详尽优化其安排。
虽然我们评价了几个块布局,但最佳时间表可能取决于数据集,任务,或模型尺度,更系统地寻找何时应该引入全球互动仍然是一个开放的方向.

blocks.en:
Global attention is currently made more efficient through spatial grid pooling, which provides a simple way to compress the token set before scene-wide interaction.
More generally, the key challenge is to reduce the number of tokens while preserving the information needed for effective scene-wide interaction.
Exploring alternative pooling, token selection, or learned compact representations may further improve this efficiency-accuracy trade-off.
blocks.zh:
目前通过空间网格集成使全球关注效率更高,这为在全场互动之前压缩符号集提供了简单的方式.
更一般地说,关键的挑战在于减少信使数量,同时保存有效全场互动所需的信息.
探索其他汇集、象征性选择或学习到的紧凑表述方式,可进一步改善这种效率准确的取舍。
